control.description-key: PBS Hub host app Detail sesi: record header, next step, absen with the live break question, Send Report (only while Schedule.Status is Waiting Report; a split live is reported in parts until Durasi covers the session), the revision form, the reports of the session, session steps and other sessions that day.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: absenLeadMin (30), reportDeadlineDays (2), requireAbsen (true), requireWaitingStatus (true), scheduleWaitingStatus (Waiting Report), scheduleDoneStatus (Done), playbooks.

property.name: ScheduleId
property.description-key: Schedule Title (SCD-…) or item ID of the session to show. Empty shows the first row of SchedulesJson.

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost. Used for the ABSEN payload.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] of this host on the session day (the session itself plus the others that day): ID, Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, JamLive, BrandID, StudioID, HostID, Platform, AccountID, Account, Position, Status.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] of this host on the session day: ID, ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime, ClockInTime, CheckInOffice, IsInsideGeofence.

property.name: AbsenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host Absence - PBS Hub] for these sessions: Title, ScheduleID, CheckInTime, Created.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for these sessions, every part of a split live: ID, Title, ScheduleID, LiveID, LiveDate, Durasi(Min), the metrics, Playbook, ApprovalStatus, ApprovalComment, Approver, Created, Modified.

property.name: EvidenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report Automation - PBS Hub] for these reports (Title = report Title): the AI reading shown on the revision form.

property.name: HistoryJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of the last reports of the host on the same platform: metrics only, for the far-from-average warnings on the form.

property.name: PlaybooksJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON of the Report.Playbook choices for the dropdown, e.g. Choices([@Report - PBS Hub].Playbook). Empty uses Context config.playbooks, else Flash Sale, Payday, Launching Produk, Reguler.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders a skeleton.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message} for ABSEN, SUBMIT_REPORT, RESUBMIT_REPORT and DISPUTE_REVIEW.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: ABSEN, SUBMIT_REPORT, RESUBMIT_REPORT, DISPUTE_REVIEW, CLOCK_IN, OPEN_REPORT, OPEN_EVIDENCE, OPEN_SCHEDULE, BACK.

property.name: UploadData
property.description-key: Base64 JPEG of the screenshot, set together with SUBMIT_REPORT / RESUBMIT_REPORT (empty otherwise). Pass it to the upload flow.
